description: How to photograph a tarot spread for a reading: light, angle, spacing, framing and background so every card is clear, with a quick checklist before you send it.
lede: A clear, level, well-lit photo lets every card in your tarot spread be identified. This guide covers light, angle, spacing and background.

do-dont.alt: Two panels side by side. The Do panel lists even light, shot from directly above, whole spread in frame, cards not overlapping, and a plain background. The Dont panel lists harsh shadows or glare, a tilted angle, cards cut off or overlapping, and a cluttered background.
do-dont.caption: Good photos come down to light, angle, spacing and background. Check each before you send your tarot spread.
